name: Dizzy Hero
description:
In this game, performing wobbly movements in front of the IR Motion Camera attached to the Joy-Con™(R) transforms you into a hero! This is a "wobbly-acting" action game full of fun and excitement!

As an agent, your mission is to infiltrate the enemy's hideout and collect classified documents.
Use your hero transformation to navigate through various traps and complete the mission!
intro: Transform into a hero with your wobbly moves in this unique action game!
